description: IBM Context Forge (MCP gateway) configuration that federates the MULTIVERSE knowledge-base retriever as an MCP tool, so any MCP-aware client (incl. Granite agents) can pull grounded World Cup facts. In the demo, FastAPI calls the retriever directly; the gateway config documents the MCP contract.

tools.name: retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve grounded football facts for a query using embedding cosine (nomic-embed-text) with a BM25 fallback over the Docling-built KB.
